tools.name: get_coverage_stats
tools.title: Database coverage
tools.description: How big the Orizn visa database is: pairs, passports, destinations, enriched records, translations and languages. Says nothing about any specific country pair — use quick_visa_check or check_visa_requirement for that. Keyless, free, and costs nothing against any quota. Call it when the user asks how complete the data is, or to confirm this server is reachable before a longer session.

tools.name: quick_visa_check
tools.title: Quick visa check
tools.description: Does this passport need a visa for this destination? Returns the requirement, the number of visa-free days, and — when that exact pair has been individually re-verified — the date it was. One pair per call, English only. Prefer it when the user wants a plain yes/no; switch to check_visa_requirement as soon as they need documents, fees, processing times, transit rules, or an answer in another language. Keyless and free: it costs nothing against an API key quota. An anonymous caller is capped at 30 DISTINCT pairs per day per network — asking the same pair again is always free, only widening costs. Free API key: https://visa.orizn.app/visa-api?source=mcp — 100 requests/month, no card, and it unlocks documents, fees, processing times, transit rules and 15 languages.
